title: skills-sync.json
description: The committed config of a skills library: the library itself, the third-party repositories it takes skills from (what is taken from each, renames, per-skill pins, attribution), and the plugins the library builds. Hand-edited and written by add; read by skills-sync refresh, sync and build.

library.description: The library itself, for the catalogs and the registry.

generate.description: The two forms, each behind a switch (both true when absent). skills: generate and link the loose-skill layers. plugins: generate plugins/<id>/ and the two marketplace catalogs. Read by build; parsed and validated here.

skills.description: Generate and link the loose-skill layers (default true).

plugins.description: Generate plugins/<id>/ and both marketplace catalogs (default true).

sources.description: One entry per source id; the id names the snapshot folder upstream/<id> and the plugin built from it.

plugins.description: One entry per plugin id: an own-skills group or a source.

releases.description: The ChatGPT upload record, one entry per plugin id, written by hand after each upload (the library's docs/agents/chatgpt-upload.md). Read by build --artifacts to say whether an archive changed since its last upload.

plugin_id.description: The plugin id ChatGPT returned on create.

release_id.description: The release id ChatGPT returned on the last create or update; an update must name it.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the archive that was uploaded, from artifacts/releases.json.

scope.description: Where the plugin lives in ChatGPT: a personal plugin, or a workspace one.

date.description: The day of the upload, YYYY-MM-DD.

files.description: The archive's entries at that upload, so a later build can say which files a new archive lacks (an update cannot delete).

repo.description: owner/repo on GitHub, a git URL, or a local path.

ref.description: The branch or tag followed: every refresh takes its tip, except skills held by a pin. A full commit holds the whole source.

version.description: The upstream version the source is held at, plain semver (1.3.0, never v1.3.0): update takes the commit of that release tag, or for a source versioned by its manifest the newest commit carrying that version. Latest when omitted. skills-sync never writes it; update --to prints the change to land.

root.description: Where skill folders live in the repo (skills, pstack/skills); the repo root when omitted.

skills.description: Selected skill folder names: a list, or a map from upstream name to working-set name for renames.

pins.description: Per-skill commits (by upstream folder name) that hold a skill while its siblings follow ref; edit the commit to move it.

attribution.description: Files copied into the snapshot and every package built from it (LICENSE, README), as upstream paths.

group.description: The own-skills group under skills/ this plugin packages.

source.description: The source id this plugin packages.
